edits.after:
- name: Historical engine applicability before setup
        id: applicability
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p soccer-results-layout-artifacts
          git rev-parse HEAD > soccer-results-layout-artifacts/source-head.txt
          git rev-parse "HEAD^{tree}" > soccer-results-layout-artifacts/source-tree.txt
          node scripts/qa/soccerResultsApplicability.mjs "$PWD" soccer-results-layout-artifacts/applicability.json 2>&1 | tee soccer-results-layout-artifacts/applicability.log
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5

edits.before:
- name: Existing recorded facts and phone restoration tests
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
edits.after:
- name: Existing recorded facts and phone restoration tests
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.applicability.outcome == 'success' }}
